claims.claim: Community text says Beast Domination, when attacking, sets AP and DP to 0 for all opposing field beasts.
conflicts_or_gaps: Duration/reset semantics, skill identifier and card ID must be verified against source card and engine.

claims.claim: Community text describes a defense-magic/counter card that sets AP to 0 for all friendly and opposing units.
conflicts_or_gaps: Duration, timing and whether only AP or additional stats are affected require card ID and engine check.

claims.claim: Community text says the number of units in the user's graveyard determines the count of opponent-used magic cards returned to the field; example: if six spells were used in order and four are recovered, spells 3 through 6 appear.
conflicts_or_gaps: Exact count threshold, source zone, target selection, and whether recover count = floor(graveyard units/5) must be confirmed; source wording says per five units but not fully formalized here.

claims.claim: Guide says lower-level magic resolves earlier; if levels tie, attack-turn player's card resolves first. Dispel status alone does not make a card first.
conflicts_or_gaps: Cross-check with official manual and engine, including enchant activation phase and exceptions; guide version date unclear.

claims.claim: Guide says enchant cards carrying the Disenchant label destroy enchant cards and can invalidate/destroy enchant effects; states they are not neutralized by enchant cards.
conflicts_or_gaps: Not necessarily same as DB29's shared 'first enchant per side' count rule; link to source text and verify.

claims.claim: Guide distinguishes LP as land-placement resource and notes LP=0 special terrains may still be playable regardless of LP.
conflicts_or_gaps: Individual terrain's printed effect and manual rules must determine applicability; don't generalize to all LP=0 terrains.
